core_obligations: Choose a representative (proof lines 4387-4395): the author replaces the object by a K-injective complex, so that the derived pushforward is computed by the direct image and both sides can be compared on sections.

Compare the restrictions (proof lines 4395-4400): the direct image along f restricted to D/V is computed by the sections over the objects of C/U, which is the same as the direct image along g of the restricted complex, using that restriction preserves K-injectivity.
proof_roadmap: Replace the object by a K-injective complex to make the pushforward explicit.
Identify the restriction of the direct image with the direct image of the restriction along the localized morphism.
Conclude the equality in the derived category.
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the restriction of a derived pushforward to a localized site with the derived pushforward of the restriction along the induced morphism of localized sites (statement lines 4373-4385). The proof chooses a K-injective representative so that the pushforward is computed explicitly (proof lines 4387-4395) and then compares the sections over the objects of the localized source, using that restriction preserves K-injectivity (proof lines 4395-4400). The non-formal content is the identification of the two localized computations. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one comparison.
